_comment: Written by tools/audit_restored.py. Per page: what read-report said after the page's own task ran, what it said after the tab was reloaded onto the autosave, and the ceiling the differences may not rise above (ADR-210).

declared.box/vList: The label is regenerated from the record and the sheet's current fields, so a label made before the chemical spot tests were typed comes back WITH them. The restored page says more, not less, and nothing that was on it has gone.

declared.box/budBox: The time budget, which carries that clock in its own text.
declared.box/ecoOut: The .eco preview stamps the session's elapsed time into the protocol it writes; the same clock, one box along.
declared.by/budBox/elapsed: The session clock. It reads the time since the session started, and a reload happens a second later than the reading before it -- a figure that came back identical would mean the clock had stopped.

declared.box/runMsg: The run pane's line about the last save or delete. Same: it reports what just happened, and nothing just happened.
declared.box/srcMsg: The source pane's own line about the last fetch -- 'Log cleared.', '412 readings from the controller export'. A sentence about an act, and a reload had no act.

declared.box/pNote: The per-plant note editor exists only while a plant is selected, and a restored run deliberately comes back with nothing selected -- the note itself is kept in the run and appears the moment a plant is picked. Coming back to the plant you were scoring is worth doing and is filed, not fixed here.

declared.box/packBox: The block that holds the pack loader and its verdict; it differs because the verdict inside it does.
declared.box/packMsg: The species-pack loader's own verdict on the last paste: 'Rejected -- 3 problems'. It is a sentence about an act, not about the sheet, and a reload had no act.

declared.box/packBox: The block that holds the pack loader and its verdict, open or closed; it differs because the verdict inside it does.
declared.box/packMsg: The pack loader's own verdict on the last paste -- 'Loaded. 2 species added'. A sentence about an act, and a reload had no act; what the pack put in the sheet is kept and comes back.
